reductionDefinition: Karp's Reduction from Exact Cover to Subset Sum
source: Karp, Richard M. Reducibility among combinatorial problems. Complexity of computer computations. Springer, Boston, MA, 1972. 85-103.
complexity: O(|S| * |X|), S = subsets, X = universal set

reductionFrom.formalDefinition: Exact Cover = {<S, X> | S is a collection of subsets of a set X where S* exists such that S* is a subcollection of S and an exact cover, of S. This means that each element of X is in exactly one subset of S*.}
reductionFrom.problemDefinition: The exact cover problem is a decision problem to determine if an exact cover exists for some <S, X>
reductionFrom.inputDescription: X, a set, and S, a collection of subsets of X
reductionFrom.outputDescription: True or False, whether an exact cover of X exists using subsets from S
reductionFrom.source: Karp, Richard M. Reducibility among combinatorial problems. Complexity of computer computations. Springer, Boston, MA, 1972. 85-103.
reductionFrom.certificateFormat: Format: {T | T subset S, union of T = X, T pairwise disjoint} Example: {{1,4},{3,5,6},{2,7}}

defaultSolver.solverDefinition: This is a generic brute force solver for Exact Cover

defaultVerifier.verifierDefinition: This is a verifier for Exact Cover

defaultVisualization.visualizationDefinition: This is a default visualization for Exact Cover

reductionTo.formalDefinition: Subset Sum = <S, T> | S is a set of positive integers and there exists a subset of S, K where the sum of K's elements equals T
reductionTo.problemDefinition: The problem is to determine whether there exists a sum of elements that totals to the number T.
reductionTo.inputDescription: S, a set of integers, and T, a target sum
reductionTo.outputDescription: True or False, whether some subset of S sums to T
reductionTo.source: Karp, Richard M. Reducibility among combinatorial problems. Complexity of computer computations. Springer, Boston, MA, 1972. 85-103.
reductionTo.instanceFormat: Format: {(S,T) | S subset int, T is int} Example: ({1,7,12,15},28)

defaultSolver.solverDefinition: This is a brute force solver for Subset Sum

defaultVerifier.verifierDefinition: This is a verifier for Subset Sum

defaultVisualization.visualizationDefinition: Draws the numbers as items and the chosen ones as a bar against the target T, and shows the selected solver trying subsets until one adds up to exactly T.

solver.solverDefinition: This is a brute force solver for Subset Sum

gadgets.note: T = 137257, a 1 in each of the 7 digits
